name: balance_stage resets the actor, fights the configured enemies and records outcome, timing and damage
contract: balance_stage reuses the Task 3 solo driver (role melee, rotation_assist with specialization 1, spell 801576) and SpawnBalanceEnemies (Task 2). Reset order per the design: revive/full health+power/clear cooldowns/despawn the previous stage's enemies/StopOwnedUnits, then (no kit here, so no opener) spawn the stage's enemies and let the solo driver fight until ResolveStage leaves Running. elite_1 fights a single level 30 Scarlet Soldier (4286), the same elite as the solo-driver regression, so the fixture kills it inside the stage cap and the step's balance object (win/ttk_s/damage_done_player/damage_taken_player) comes from a real fight, not a forced outcome. set_health gives the fixture the same 20000/20000 health pool as the solo-driver regression (its bare gear would otherwise die to this elite, as a first run of this scenario measured: 1122 max health against 1161 damage taken). after_reset repeats the same single elite to prove the reset between balance_stage calls actually restores full health: balance_last_reset_health is read right after ResetBalanceStageActor runs, before the second fight can lower it again, and is asserted equal to max_health via a ratio_to snapshot.

steps.label: SETUP: the fighter's max health before any stage
elite_1 reports a positive time to kill
elite_1 recorded the player dealing damage
elite_1 recorded the player taking damage
Return to the fixed fight spot: elite_1's chase can drift the fighter away from it
after_reset's reset gave the fighter full health before the second fight could lower it again
after_reset also ends in a win, independent of elite_1's own record
